content.what_this_is: Fenwick Borough Council says your council tax instalment from 1 October 2026 is not paid.
what_to_do: Pay the unpaid instalment in full.
Pay it within 7 days of the date of the letter.
Or visit fenwick.example/ctax to arrange a payment plan.
Ask about a council tax reduction if you are on a low income.

by_when.what: Pay the unpaid instalment to avoid enforcement action and extra costs

amounts.what: Additional costs if you do not pay

safety_lines: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.

steps.text: Pay the unpaid instalment in full.
steps.text_en: Pay the unpaid instalment in full.

steps.text: Note the unpaid instalment, due 1 October 2026, is £212.50.
